title: CTRES v1.0 R12 Report Reference
description: A link between CTRES records and reports filed with other authorities (§4.12). R12 never carries the content of a suspicious transaction report. Where tipping-off and confidentiality rules apply, R12 is held by the operator and disclosed only to an authority entitled by law to see it; periodic packages then carry counts and timeliness only (see manifest report_reference_counts).

destination_authority.description: Authority to which the report was filed (§4.12).

channel.description: Channel used: goAML, a national reporting API, a regulator portal or other (§4.12).

profile_rule_ref.description: The profile rule that triggered the report, written <profile_id>@<profile_version>#<rule_id> (§4.12; §5).

related_record_ids.description: Records that triggered or support the report, by identifier (§4.12).

receipt_ref.description: The receipt, acknowledgement or file identifier the destination issued (§4.12).
receipt_ref.x-ctres-condition: Where the destination issued a receipt (§4.12).
